title: Dependency metadata rewritten by package extensions
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a `packageExtensions` block that rewrites the metadata of a published package. The installed graph no longer matches what the publisher declared, so the review reads a different dependency set than the one that installs.
remediation: Land the fix upstream, or scope the extension to a private fork with its own review.
limitation: It matches a `packageExtensions` block that rewrites the metadata of a published package in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
